entries.144f044a3980068c: In its 2024 Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years 2024–2026), the company sets out as its basic policy to build a strong yet flexible Q'd with 'people' at the center, and works on three priorities: strengthening human capital through investment in people, polishing Q'd so that it is chosen by customers, and strengthening connections with all people and organizations involved with the company.
